descriptions.zh-Hans: 在杭州吃过龙井虾仁后画的菜单。白色虾仁旁边点着几笔绿色，纸上也给茶叶留了座位。
descriptions.en: A menu drawn after a plate of Longjing tea shrimp in Hangzhou. Small green strokes have their own places among the pale shrimp.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在杭州吃过片儿川后画的小菜单。雪菜、笋片和肉片各占一角，面条绕了满满一圈。
descriptions.en: A little menu from a bowl of Pian’erchuan in Hangzhou. Greens, bamboo shoots and pork each get a corner; the noodles take the scenic route.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在西湖边画的堤道草稿，纸太小，线条一直画到折痕上。翻开另一面，空着的地方还很多。
descriptions.en: My causeway sketch from West Lake ran straight into a fold in the paper. Turn it over and there is still plenty of room.

names.en: A Seat for a Tea Leaf

descriptions.zh-Hans: 吃过龙井虾仁，我在余纸上给一片画出来的茶叶添了张椅子。这只是我的饭后涂鸦。
descriptions.en: After the Longjing shrimp, I drew a chair for a sketched tea leaf on spare paper. A small after-lunch invention.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 逛完茶博龙井馆区，我和一位游客把同一个问号画成了两片叶子。他把这张问路纸留给了我。
descriptions.en: After the tea museum’s Longjing branch, another visitor and I turned one question mark into two leaves. They let me keep our scrap of directions.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我和另一位旅人把两张西湖速写接在一起，添了同一只歪歪的小邮包。他留下了整张长笺，让那只邮包跟我继续走。
descriptions.en: Another traveler joined their West Lake sketch to mine. We added one very crooked mailbag, then they gave me the whole folded strip so it could keep traveling.
